description: This file implements classes and functions related to blocking closures for inter-process communication, including factory methods, semaphore-based blocking closure, and poll-based blocking closure within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: BlockingClosurePoll
classes.description: Implements a poll-based blocking closure that processes IPC channel events until a condition is met.

classes.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a semaphore-based blocking closure for synchronization.

methods.name: IBlockingClosureFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a factory for blocking closures.

methods.name: BlockingClosureFactory::createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure that uses polling on an IPC channel.

methods.name: BlockingClosureFactory::createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure that uses a semaphore for synchronization.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::BlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Constructor initializing the poll-based blocking closure with an IPC channel.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::Run
methods.description: Sets the internal done flag to true, indicating completion.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::wait
methods.description: Waits on the IPC channel, processing events until the closure is marked as done.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::Run
methods.description: Posts to the semaphore to signal completion.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::wait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore, blocking until signaled.
